text:
deploy-bot: :warning: EMERG PIN applied by nina: runtime v6.0 pinned for model-group 'multi-llama' in us-east-1 due to regression causing KV cache evictions and regenerated tokens mismatch. Auto-pin window: 4h. See https://ops/incident/3609998888

nina: hit customer report + internal alerts at 14:12 EDT. mismatch rate ~0.4% and KV evictions skyrocketed after autoscaler change + sdk 5.2.0 canary.

carlos: telemetry correlation shows kernel handshake failing on quantized attention after round-robin scheduling tweak. p50 unaffected but token-level diffs are concerning for safety/regression.

priya: immediate mitigation: pin runtime v6.0 in region (done), route traffic for model prefix 'prod-*' to runtime v5.8, and drain new canary traffic. we should also pause sdk 5.2.0 canary.

deploy-bot: Useful ops commands:

```
/deploy pin runtime v6.0 --model multi-llama --region us-east-1 --by nina --reason "token diff + kv-evict regression"
/deploy route add --from runtime:v6.0 --to runtime:v5.8 --region us-east-1 --match "model_prefix=prod-" --drain 2m
/deploy canary pause sdk 5.2.0
```

infra-bot: note: dedicated-capacity in us-east-1 has 8 spare nodes; if we need scale-up for routing we can allocate with `infra allocate`.

nina: i've applied the routing rule. quick smoke shows token-diff rate down to 0.02% for prod prefixes. non-prod still hitting diffs at ~0.3% which is helpful for debugging.

carlos: i'm opening a patch PR to the runtime kernel handshake and adding a compatibility toggle for the round-robin scheduler. PR: https://git/repo/pull/7890

priya: schedule for soft-unpin: don't unpin until runtime patch merges and sdk canary is paused/verified. proposed plan: after patch lands, soft-unpin in low-traffic window (00:30 UTC) with canary ramp 3% -> 20% -> 80% -> 100% and 10m gates. rollback triggers: token-diff > 0.1% OR 5xx > 5 in 10m OR kv-evict rate > baseline+50%.

nina: add monitoring rule and notifications: if token-diff alert fires, page #eng-oncall and tag @carlos @priya immediately.

deploy-bot: Reminder: To request manual unpin before schedule run `/deploy unpin runtime v6.0 --region us-east-1` and include eng-releases approval.

carlos: one more ask: add unit/regression tests in CI to compare token streams for quantized model sets across runtime versions—catch this earlier. i'll add to the PR.

priya: drafting internal release note: "Temporary pin of runtime v6.0 for multi-llama in us-east-1 due to token mismatch and KV eviction regression. Traffic for production prefixes routed to v5.8; rollback/soft-unpin plan pending runtime patch. Customer-facing impact: small subset of regenerated outputs may have differed; mitigation applied." will post to #release-notes-draft.

nina: good. i'll keep this thread updated with PR links and gate numbers. close when soft-unpin completes and all regression tests pass. :lock:
